_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing a ±2+ point move and no breaker identified, HOLD is the statistically honest call inside this coil even as the August bottom analog hints at eventual mean reversion.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing no release mechanism; narrative implies a forward UP bias via the bottom blueprint analog
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 30, stablecoin growth turns positive, and BTC momentum breaks +5% within 48h
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear/Greed drops below 20 with BTC momentum turning negative, or VIX breaks 20 with DXY cracking 101 and funding pushing 0.015%
